toolCallId.description: Unique identifier for this tool call

toolName.description: Name of the tool being executed

toolTitle.description: Human-readable display title for the tool, when the selected tool descriptor has a non-empty title.

shellToolInfo.description: Shell-tool path hints derived from the command at start time for shell tools (bash/powershell/local_shell). Produced by the same shell-aware extractor as PermissionRequestShell.possiblePaths, so it is present even when the command is auto-approved and no permission request fires. Absent for non-shell tools.

model.description: Model identifier that generated this tool call

rte.description: Per-request treatment/eligibility signal returned by the Copilot API in the `X-GitHub-Copilot-Request-TE` response header for the associated model call; `false` when the header was absent or unparseable.

mcpServerName.description: Name of the MCP server hosting this tool, when the tool is an MCP tool

mcpConfigServerName.description: Preferred lookup name for the MCP server hosting this tool: the configured (namespaced) config-map key when the tool carries one, otherwise the display name from `mcpServerName`. Present when the tool is an MCP tool; this is the name unrestricted provenance telemetry hashes so it joins with `mcp_server_setup`, which keys off the configured name too.

mcpToolName.description: Original tool name on the MCP server, when the tool is an MCP tool

mcpTransport.description: Transport the MCP server hosting this tool is connected over, when the tool is an MCP tool and the server is configured

mcpConfigSource.description: Where the MCP server's configuration came from (`user`, `workspace`, `plugin`, or `builtin`), when the tool is an MCP tool and the server is configured

turnId.description: Identifier for the agent loop turn this tool was invoked in, matching the corresponding assistant.turn_start event

displayVerbatim.description: When true, the tool output should be displayed expanded (verbatim) in the CLI timeline

toolDescription.description: Tool definition metadata, present for MCP tools with MCP Apps support

parentToolCallId.description: Tool call ID of the parent tool invocation when this event originates from a sub-agent

fusion.description: Experimental HydraFusion attribution for this tool execution.

ToolExecutionStartData.description: Tool execution startup details including MCP server information when applicable
ToolExecutionStartData.title: ToolExecutionStartData

toolCallId.description: Unique identifier for the completed tool call

success.description: Whether the tool execution completed successfully

model.description: Model identifier that generated this tool call

mcpMeta.description: FIDES IFC label projected from tool ingress metadata (MCP `CallToolResult._meta` or synthesized built-in ingress labels). Persisted as `{ ifc: ... }` so the label survives session resume, including model-visible failure results. Experimental.

interactionId.description: CAPI interaction ID for correlating this tool execution with upstream telemetry

rte.description: Per-request treatment/eligibility signal returned by the Copilot API in the `X-GitHub-Copilot-Request-TE` response header for the associated model call; `false` when the header was absent or unparseable.

isUserRequested.description: Whether this tool call was explicitly requested by the user rather than the assistant

error.description: Error details when the tool execution failed

toolTelemetry.description: Tool-specific telemetry data (e.g., CodeQL check counts, grep match counts)

turnId.description: Identifier for the agent loop turn this tool was invoked in, matching the corresponding assistant.turn_start event

toolDescription.description: Tool definition metadata, present for MCP tools with MCP Apps support

sandboxed.description: Whether this tool execution ran inside a sandbox container

shellExecution.description: Experimental shell completion facts captured before the persisted result contents are stripped.

parentToolCallId.description: Tool call ID of the parent tool invocation when this event originates from a sub-agent

fusion.description: Experimental HydraFusion attribution for this tool completion.

ToolExecutionCompleteData.description: Tool execution completion results including success status, detailed output, and error information
ToolExecutionCompleteData.title: ToolExecutionCompleteData

content.description: Concise tool result text sent to the LLM for chat completion, potentially truncated for token efficiency

detailedContent.description: Detailed tool result for UI/timeline display, preserving complete content such as diffs for most tools. Successful skill invocations intentionally use the concise model-facing content here; the authoritative skill body is carried by the corresponding skill invocation event. Falls back to content when absent.

items.description: A content block within a tool result, which may be text, terminal output, image, audio, or a resource

contents.description: Structured content blocks (text, images, audio, resources) returned by the tool in their native format

items.description: A model-facing binary result as persisted: full inline data, a size-omitted marker, or a deduplicated asset reference

binaryResultsForLlm.description: Model-facing binary results (base64 inline or size-omitted markers) sent to the LLM for this tool call

uiResource.description: MCP Apps UI resource content for rendering in a sandboxed iframe

structuredContent.description: Structured content (arbitrary JSON) returned verbatim by the MCP tool

items.description: A source supplied by a tool that should be made available to the model as citable content.

citableSources.description: Provider-neutral source material this tool makes available to the model as citable content. Persisted so it survives session resume. Experimental.

mcpMeta.description: FIDES IFC label projected from tool ingress metadata (MCP `CallToolResult._meta` or synthesized built-in ingress labels) — persisted as `{ ifc: ... }` (only the `ifc` key, not the whole `_meta`). Persisted so the FIDES IFC label survives session resume: the engine rehydrates accumulated taint by replaying these on load. Populated for ingress sources when FIDES IFC is on. Experimental.

remediation.description: What the user must do to recover, when the runtime knows of an action. Set on sandbox policy denials, where `message` names the rule that blocked the call but never the client affordance that relaxes it.

ToolExecutionCompleteError.description: Error details when the tool execution failed
ToolExecutionCompleteError.title: ToolExecutionCompleteError

requestId.description: Unique identifier for this permission request; used to respond via session.respondToPermission()

permissionRequest.description: Details of the permission being requested

promptRequest.description: Derived user-facing permission prompt details for UI consumers

permissionMode.description: Permission mode captured when evaluation began. Absent on historical events.

agentMode.description: Agent mode captured from the owning turn when permission evaluation began.

riskAssessment.description: Neutral risk metadata supplied by the tool host. Consumers may display this value but must not use it to bypass the permission decision.

resolvedByHook.description: When true, this permission was already resolved by a permissionRequest hook and requires no client action

recoveryEpisodeId.description: Permission-recovery episode that authorized this request to surface for interactive attention

PermissionRequestedData.description: Permission request notification requiring client approval with request details
PermissionRequestedData.title: PermissionRequestedData

id.description: Unique event identifier (UUID v4), generated when the event is emitted

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event was created

parentId.description: ID of the chronologically preceding event in the session, forming a linked chain. Null for the first event.

ephemeral.description: When true, the event is transient and not persisted to the session event log on disk

agentId.description: Sub-agent instance identifier. Absent for events from the root/main agent and session-level events.

data.description: Permission request notification requiring client approval with request details

PermissionRequestedEvent.description: Session event "permission.requested". Permission request notification requiring client approval with request details
PermissionRequestedEvent.title: PermissionRequestedEvent

limit: Referenced definitions are not expanded; schemas describe leads, not observed emission or enforcement.
